description: React component for a Signup page allowing users to create an account with role selection (student or educator). It includes form validation, integration with authentication context, and navigation upon submission.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates form inputs for name, email, password, and role.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles input change events to update form state.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, performs validation, calls signup, and navigates based on response.
